TerpPilot — research prototype 01

For educational product comparison only. Cannabinoid and terpene composition does not establish intoxication, therapeutic benefit, or subjective effect. ND means not detected; <LOQ means below the limit of quantitation; unavailable values are not zero. Figures reflect specific published COAs and may not describe products currently for sale. Unlisted analytes are not confirmed zeros; the matching vector approximates their contribution as zero. Partial panels are labeled. Product format is inferred from the product name when the lab matrix is less specific. No purchasing or dosing features.
